gaps: The template's 18650 lithium pack is marked absent.
The parts list gives a 24V/250W motor, but it is left out: the manuals do not state the motor type, and the catalogue's motor key is for brushless hub motors while this scooter is chain-driven.
Charger output and model years are not stated.
method: Two Razor E300/E300S owner's manuals agree on the parts list and charger, and both say the battery is sealed lead-acid (parts list: 2x 12V/7Ah).

comps.spec: Battery listed as 2x 12V/7Ah (parts list item 21). The manual says the product uses sealed lead-acid batteries that must be recycled.
comps.loc: Parts list also names a battery tray (item 11) and battery bracket (item 22); the text does not describe how the battery is mounted

comps.spec: Control Module, item 10 on the parts list. Troubleshooting says to replace the Control Module when the motor does not engage and makes no clicking sound.
Charger supplied in the box. Its light is green at the wall outlet (standby), red while charging and green when charging is complete. Initial charge 12 hours; recharge up to 12 hours.
On/Off switch, item 13 on the parts list. The manual says to switch it off when the unit is not in use, since leaving it on for a long time can leave the battery unable to hold a charge.
comps.loc: On the scooter; location only in the page 4 diagram, not in the text

comps.spec: Reset button, item 12 on the parts list. It trips when the motor is overloaded, for example by a heavy rider or a steep hill. The manual says to wait a few seconds and then press it.
comps.loc: On the scooter; location only in the page 4 diagram, not in the text

comps.spec: Charger port, item 14 on the parts list. The charger plugs into it.
comps.loc: On the scooter; location only in the page 4 diagram, not in the text

comps.spec: Chain, item 19 on the parts list, with a chain tensioner (item 18) and chain guard (item 20).
comps.loc: Rear wheel drive: the Chain and Rear Tire Replacement section installs the chain on the rear wheel sprocket
